coverageNote: GeckoTerminal paginates to page 10 (~200 pools per Uniswap version per chain), ordered by 24h volume. This is the deepest the public API allows and is not every Uniswap pool.
feeNote: GeckoTerminal exposes no fee field. Tiers are read from the pool name (v2 is a fixed 0.30%). Fees are gross fees generated by swaps, not LP take-home, and are unavailable for v4 dynamic-fee and hook pools.
